cards.whatHappened: Driver is about 115 km out with a 15:58 CEST ETA, but Calverona Auto says the receiving contact cannot take the car after early afternoon, and nobody authorized to sign is named. The delivery promise (Munich, 11:00–16:00 CEST) is at risk, and a person must settle a receiver or new slot with the customer.

findings.text: The delivery site says at 11:20 CEST it has no named person authorized to sign, and a 15:58 CEST arrival won't work with the receiving contact.
GPS at 10:25 CEST showed 115 km to go with an app ETA in Munich of 15:58 CEST.
The delivery promise is Wed 21 Oct 11:00–16:00 CEST in Munich.
Calverona Auto said at 09:59 CEST the receiving contact cannot take the car after early afternoon on Wed 21 Oct.
Calverona Auto said at 10:42 CEST the address can be accessed until 18:00 local, but it still cannot say who is authorized to inspect and sign.
Calverona Auto wrote on Tue 20 Oct at 12:17 CEST: "We can discuss another slot if the driver cannot make it safely."

params.text: Ask for a named person authorized to inspect and sign for the Bentley in Munich who can attend between about 15:30 and 18:00 CEST today. If nobody, agree a new delivery slot (e.g. tomorrow morning) and confirm the car stays with the driver until then.

proposal.effect_text: A person calls the customer; the driver is told to keep driving but not hand over car or keys. Nothing is rebooked or changed in the delivery time until the call outcome.
